dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular, jagged ovoid and 'O' shaped light-intensity perimeters with high-frequency edge variability; gradients transition from a bright exterior ring to a lower-intensity, dark-pixel interior core.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid, high-intensity white pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily concentrated along the lower lateral flank and the distal margins of the hind flippers.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Primary dorsal macro-annuli centroids form a series of interconnected obtuse triangles across the mid-section, transitioning to a linear chain of three points along the lower lateral curvature.
